article.title: Coligación: patrón léxico + estructura
article.part: Formación de palabras y léxico-gramática — Formação de palavras e léxico-gramática
article.chapter: Léxico-gramática, regencia y colocaciones — Léxico-gramática, regência e colocações

claims.sectionKey: La coligación describe la tendencia de una palabra o expresión a aparecer en determinadas estructuras gramaticales
claims.summary: The collocation describes the tendency of a word or expression to appear in certain grammatical structures.

claims.sectionKey: Por ejemplo, un verbo puede aparecer con mucha frecuencia seguido de una preposición concreta o de una cláusula introducida por que
claims.summary: For example, a verb can frequently appear followed by a specific preposition or a clause introduced by 'que'.

claims.sectionKey: Las preferencias de coligación pueden variar según género textual, registro y significado
claims.summary: The preferences of collocation can vary according to textual gender, register, and meaning.

claims.sectionKey: Una palabra polisémica puede presentar más de un patrón
claims.summary: A polysyllabic word can present more than one pattern.

links.notes: The source explicitly states that collocation refers to the tendency of a word or expression to appear in specific grammatical structures.
The source provides an example of a verb appearing with a preposition or a clause introduced by 'que', illustrating the concept of collocation.
The source mentions that collocation preferences can vary based on textual gender, register, and meaning.
The source states that a word with multiple meanings can exhibit more than one collocational pattern.
